parsed_plans.sql: SELECT SUM("keyword"."id" + "title"."episode_of_id") as agg_0 FROM "keyword" LEFT OUTER JOIN "movie_keyword" ON "keyword"."id" = "movie_keyword"."keyword_id" LEFT OUTER JOIN "title" ON "movie_keyword"."movie_id" = "title"."id" LEFT OUTER JOIN "movie_info" ON "title"."id" = "movie_info"."movie_id"  WHERE "keyword"."id" <= 59292 AND "title"."series_years" != '1964-1970' AND "movie_keyword"."movie_id" >= 1753838 AND "movie_info"."info_type_id" = 57 AND "movie_info"."movie_id" >= 418592;

SELECT COUNT(*) as agg_0 FROM "role_type" LEFT OUTER JOIN "cast_info" ON "role_type"."id" = "cast_info"."role_id" LEFT OUTER JOIN "title" ON "cast_info"."movie_id" = "title"."id" LEFT OUTER JOIN "kind_type" ON "title"."kind_id" = "kind_type"."id"  WHERE "role_type"."role" != 'producer' AND "title"."imdb_index" = 'VIII' AND "kind_type"."id" >= 6 AND "kind_type"."kind" != 'video movie' AND "role_type"."id" != 8;
